title: Leaks like crazy
text: Leaks like crazy. Easy to fill, fits in cupboard and easy one hand operation BUT….it leaks like crazy.  Awful.  Too late to return.  this thing made a mess out of my cabinets.  I just ordered something else we will see how it goes! But I cannot recommend this product.

product_metadata.title: AYOTEE Auto Flip Oil Dispenser Bottle,550ml 18.6 OZ Glass Cooking Oil Container with Automatic Cap and Non-Drip Spout,Gravity Olive Oil Dispenser Bottle for Kitchen,Barbecue,Baking,Roasting(Blue)…
features: ✔【Automatic Opening and Closing Cap】AYOTEE oil dispenser for kitchen which adopts the principle of gravity. The ABS material flip lid will open automatically when the bottle is tilted, and close when upright. Enjoy the fun of cooking with one-handed operation, saving time and effort. Not only a small olive oil dispenser, but also a oil vinegar bottle, soy sauce dispenser etc. The stylish look adds a wonderful touch to your kitchen.

✔【Stainless Spout and Relative Wide Bottle Mouth Design】The 304 stainless U-shaped spout enables you control the amount of pouring oil exactly. No need to worry oil drip or leak from the spout when cooking, keep the oil bottle and countertop clean. With the relative wide-diameter oil and vinegar dispenser mouth design, it is easy to refill oil or vinegar into the olive oil dispensers. Providing you a convenient cooking experience by using AYOTEE oil and vinegar bottles.

✔【Safe & Durable Materials】The glass oil dispenser is made of food grade BPA-free PP material and lead-free glass, which ensure the oil vinegar or soy sauce in a fresh condition. Perfect to hold different liquid condiments. AYOTEE strong glass olive oil dispenser bottle haven't a handle so that it is easier to storage for taking up less space than those oil bottle dispensers. It also allows one-handed pouring even without handle. Wide bottle neck for easy cleaning.

✔【Practical Glass Oil Bottles for Kitchen】With a large capacity of 18.6 Oz(550ml), it is an ideal olive oil container for holding condiments such as olive oil, vinegar, soy sauce and more. Measuring 3.15”x2.56”x9.85”(L/W/H) the cruet perfectly fits many cabinets or kitchen racks. This cooking oil bottle is not resistant to high temperature so it is not suitable for dishwasher. Please use warm or cold water when cleaning. And it is convenient to clean interior of the bottle with soft brush.

✔【Ideal Kitchen Gifts & Sincere Customer Service】These oil dispenser bottles are tested strictly before they are sent out. They are made of good materials (ABS, food grade PP and 304 stainless). You can rest assured that these kitchen oil dispenser safe and sturdy. It can also be an impressive gift for many occasions.
